text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic wardrobe product photograph. Pure white seamless background and soft neutral studio lighting. No person, skin, body parts, visible mannequin or stand. Entire objects visible, faithful texture. 米白珠串小手包。仅此单件配饰，成对耳饰或手套作为一组，无其他物品。
original_prompt: Single-object e-commerce photograph of ONE small ivory white beaded flower handbag with a short pearl-beaded top handle and layered ivory petal-shaped decoration. Entire handbag and handle visible, centered and large. Pure white background and neutral studio lighting, realistic beads and fabric. No dress, no clothing, no other objects, no people, no text.
